seriesTitle: The partner who vanished with everything

parts.title: The partner who vanished - part 1
parts.story: Crashing out. That's the only way to describe what I did when I opened our business bank account and saw a balance of eleven dollars. My partner Danny and I had built our company for six years. Two days earlier there was almost four hundred thousand dollars in that account. Now there was eleven dollars and Danny wasn't answering his phone. I drove to his apartment and the landlord told me he'd moved out over the weekend, no forwarding address. I sat in my car and genuinely thought I was going to be sick. But right before I left, the landlord mentioned Danny had left one box behind in the storage unit, and he'd been trying to reach him to come get it. I asked if I could take a look. Inside that box was a single folder, and what was written on the first page made my blood run cold. Part 2 is on my profile.
parts.caption: My business partner vanished with $400k 😳 follow for part 2

parts.title: The partner who vanished - part 2
parts.story: Crashing out. So I'm sitting in a storage unit holding a folder my partner Danny left behind after emptying our company account. The first page was a printed flight confirmation, one way, to a city I'd never heard him mention. But it was the second page that got me. It was a business registration form, for a brand new company, in Danny's name, dated three weeks ago, while he was still smiling in our office every morning. He'd been planning this. He didn't panic and steal, he built an exit for a month while looking me in the eye. Under the registration was a sticky note with a phone number and two initials that weren't his. Someone helped him. Someone who knew our finances well enough to move four hundred thousand dollars in one afternoon. And when I realized whose initials those were, I almost crashed out right there on the storage room floor. Part 3 is on my profile.
parts.caption: He'd been planning it for a MONTH 😤 follow for part 3

parts.title: The partner who vanished - part 3
parts.story: Crashing out. The initials on that sticky note were R.M. Our accountant. Rebecca. The one person besides me and Danny with full access to move company money. I didn't call her. I didn't warn her. Instead I did something calmer than I've ever been in my life. I called our bank and asked for the transfer records, which as a listed owner I still had the right to request. It took two days. When the records came, they showed the four hundred thousand didn't go to Danny at all. It went to a third account, one I didn't recognize, and Rebecca was the one who authorized it. Danny wasn't the mastermind. Danny was the distraction. He was the name everyone would chase while the real money sat somewhere else entirely. I printed everything, drove to Rebecca's office, and sat in the parking lot rehearsing what I'd say. Then I saw who walked out of her building, and the whole story flipped again. Part 4 is on my profile.
parts.caption: Plot twist: it wasn't even about Danny 👀 follow for part 4

parts.title: The partner who vanished - part 4
parts.story: Lock in. The person who walked out of Rebecca's office was Danny. The partner who supposedly vanished across the country was standing in a parking lot two miles from our office, laughing with the accountant who moved our money. So the flight confirmation was fake. The whole disappearing act was staged to make me chase a ghost while they cleaned everything out quietly. I sat in my car filming them on my phone, hands shaking, and I made a decision. I didn't confront them. I didn't lose it. I locked in. I drove straight to a lawyer with the bank records, the fake company registration, and now video of the two of them together. The lawyer looked at everything, went quiet, and said four words I'll never forget: they made one mistake. That mistake was the third account, because of whose name was actually on it. And it wasn't Danny's, and it wasn't Rebecca's. Part 5 is on my profile.
parts.caption: He never even left town 💀 follow for part 5

parts.title: The partner who vanished - part 5
parts.story: Caught in 4k. Here's how it ended. That third account, the one holding our four hundred thousand dollars, was opened under a shell company. And the name listed as the registered agent, the legal owner on paper, was Danny's brother, who had no idea any of this was happening. When the lawyer subpoenaed the account, Danny's brother panicked and told investigators everything to save himself, including where Danny and Rebecca were planning to move the money next. The police froze the account before they could touch it. I got every dollar back. Danny and Rebecca were both charged, caught in 4k by their own paper trail. And Danny's brother, the one they used as a human shield, testified against them. The company I almost lost is still running today, and I hired a new accountant who I watch like a hawk. People who plan to betray you always leave one loose thread. Follow me, because the next story is about a loose thread that took down someone even bigger.
parts.caption: I got every dollar back 😤 #storytime #revenge
